card.name: Section numbers and 'may have' in NSAID warnings
card.fires_on: The first digit of a section cross-reference in parentheses, such as (2.3) or (5.3), in label highlights. Also the word 'have' after 'may' in the NSAID warning that patients on diuretics or ACE inhibitors may have impaired response.

modes.label: Section cross-reference digit
modes.description: The leading number inside a parenthesized section reference like (5.3) after a warning sentence.
modes.example: Dose adjustment may be needed in some patients ( <<2>>.3 ) Pramipexole

modes.label: 'may have' before impaired response
modes.description: The word 'have' after 'may' in the NSAID warning about diuretics, ACE inhibitors or ARBs.
modes.example: Patients taking thiazides or loop diuretics may<< have>> impaired response to these therapies when taking NSA

card.plain: It fires on section-number references in label summaries and on the 'may have impaired response' wording in NSAID drug-interaction warnings.
